title: Case Against Liang Ngoh, Ex-Detective Inspector, S.C.G. Police Bureau, Before City Court For Extortion And Making False Accusation Against Commissioner Tsai

page_data.en:
CONFIDENTIAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.S, Special Branch.
REPORT
File No. S.T. RLO. B. D. 7774
2 37
Date February 8, 1937.

Subject Case against Liang Ngoh, ex-Detective Inspector, S.C.G. Police Bureau,
before City Court for extortion and making false accusation against
Commissioner Tsai and
Made by ____________________ Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao-liang.

Detective Liang Ngoh (梁五) was taken on about a
year ago by ex-Chief Detective Officer Chi Yuen Fu, but was
dismissed in September last when Mr. Liu Hwa, the present Chief
Detective, took over charge.
After leaving the Force, it was discovered that Liang
Ngoh, during his tenure of office had extorted a sum of $100
from a Buddhist monk named Cheh Yen living in the City, in
connection with a charge of opium smoking but had failed to
effect the monk's release as had been promised. The Detective
had also filed a petition with the Executive Yuan charging
Commissioner Tsai with receiving bribes from subordinates on
their appointment and from opium smugglers who transported
contraband to Shanghai.
This so enraged General Tsai that he ordered the
arrest of this ex-Detective and handed him to the City Court
for trial.
The case is still pending. It is doubtful whether
the ex-Detective is in a position to prove his accusation against
General Tsai and it is a certainty that he will be convicted
on the extortion charge as the complainant (the monk) will
appear in Court to give evidence.

Tan Shaoliang
Superintendent.

（批：Dil / 5th）
（批：a.f. / D.C. (Special Branch). / DBR. 2/2）
（批：DC (c)）

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / SPECIAL BRANCH / 3 FEB. 1937 / SHANGHAI）
（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER OF POLICE / 3 FEB 1937 / SHANGHAI）
page_data.zh:
机密
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别科。
报告
档案编号：S.T. RLO. B. D. 7774
2 37
日期：1937年2月8日。

事由：前上海市公安局巡官梁五（Liang Ngoh）在市府法院被控敲诈勒索及诬告蔡厅长一案，
由 ___ 呈报，经谭绍良警司转呈。

巡官梁五（梁五）约于一年前由前任首席探员季元福（Chi Yuen Fu，音译）录用，但在去年九月现任首席探员刘华（Liu Hwa，音译）接掌职务时被开除。
离职后，经查实梁五在任职期间曾就一起吸食鸦片指控案，向居住在市区的名叫彻严（Cheh Yen，音译）的佛教僧侣敲诈银洋100元，但未能如承诺般使该僧侣获释。该巡官还向行政院递交请愿书，指控蔡厅长在下属任命时收受贿赂，以及从将违禁品运至上海的鸦片走私者处收受贿赂。
此举激怒了蔡将军，他下令逮捕这名前巡官，并将其移送市府法院受审。
此案仍在审理中。这名前巡官能否证明其对蔡将军的指控尚存疑问，但他因敲诈勒索罪名被定罪则是确定无疑的，因为原告（该僧侣）将出庭作证。

谭绍良
警司。

（批：Dil / 5th）
（批：a.f. / 副警长（特别科）。/ DBR. 2/2）
（批：DC (c)）

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 特别科 / 1937年2月3日 / 上海）
（印：警务处副警长 / 1937年2月3日 / 上海）
